verdict.rationale: Temporal's core purpose is durable background execution. Schedules start Workflow Executions at specific times, Activities retry automatically, and workflows resume after crashes or multi-day waits. Long-running agent loops that call LLMs and tools are documented, and Serverless Workers on Lambda or Cloud Run autoscale with no infrastructure to manage. Users report running alert-handling, provisioning and Reverse ETL systems on it, though one reports trouble detecting and responding programmatically to workflows stuck in-progress with errors. Missing for 10: a low-code or no-code way to set up automations (everything is SDK code plus Workers), and independent evidence that unattended workflows surface failures cleanly for automated recovery.
